bpmn-spec.json
# CLI Conventions (authoring)

This reference covers the **authoring-side** CLI surface only: the read-only
registry discovery commands used to produce a valid, importable Maestro `.bpmn`
file. The registry commands below never mutate cloud state. Operate and diagnose
use different CLI commands — see
[operate/CAPABILITY.md](operate/CAPABILITY.md) and
[diagnose/CAPABILITY.md](diagnose/CAPABILITY.md).

## Discovery commands (read-only, authoring-safe)

All commands below are discovery/read-only. None mutate cloud state.

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `uip maestro bpmn registry pull [-f\|--force]` | Sync and cache the registry. Without login, only OOTB extension types are synced; login adds discovered connectors and processes. |
| `uip maestro bpmn registry list [--limit <n\|-1>]` | List cached extension types (and discovered connectors/processes). Default 30; use `--limit -1` for all. |
| `uip maestro bpmn registry search <keyword>` | Find entries by keyword across extension type, label, connector name, process name. |
| `uip maestro bpmn registry get <extensionType> [--connection-id <id>] [--object-name <name>]` | Get the full spec for one extension type: `xmlTemplate`, `contextFields`, `bindingInfo`, input/output patterns. `--connection-id`/`--object-name` add live Integration Service field metadata for `Intsvc.*` connector types. |
| `uip is connections list --all-folders` | List live Integration Service connections (id + state) across all folders. Always pass `--all-folders`; a folder-scoped list silently misses connections. |

These are the registry/discovery commands the skill verifies against the CLI
source (`packages/maestro-tool/src/commands/registry.ts`). Do not invent flags.
Validation uses `uip maestro bpmn validate <file>` — see
[Validation](structural-bpmn.md#validation).

The `validate` command runs the full PO.Frontend canvas rule set offline (it was
added to the CLI in UiPath/cli#3135). If your CLI reports `validate` as an
unknown command, or it clearly runs only the deploy-readiness checks and not the
structural rules, the installed CLI predates that change — update to the latest:

```bash
npm install -g @uipath/cli@latest   # or: bun add -g @uipath/cli
```

> **Don't conclude "it doesn't exist" from truncated discovery output.** A row past a cutoff reads exactly like a missing row. Two cutoffs bite here: `registry list` defaults to **30** — pass `--limit -1` for the full set — and piping `registry search`/`is connections list` through `head`/`tail`/`grep -m`/a pager drops everything past the cap. To check existence, narrow the query (keyword to `registry search`, `--all-folders` to connection lists) rather than capping rows; cap only data already known complete.

## Output parsing

Whenever a CLI result is parsed programmatically, pass `--output json`. If a
command does not support JSON, do not silently scrape human text; keep the step
manual and tell the user.

## Login boundary

Local source authoring and `uip maestro bpmn validate` work without login (the
validator runs fully offline). Registry
discovery of **connectors and processes** (and Integration Service field
enrichment) requires `uip login`. Without login, `registry pull` still returns
the built-in (OOTB) extension types.

## Never fabricate an identifier

Connection IDs, `releaseKey`/process keys, queue keys, connector keys, app IDs,
folder IDs/paths — every concrete identifier comes from discovery
(`registry get`, `registry search`, `uip is connections list`) or from the user.
Never invent one. When a required identifier is unknown, leave the placeholder
in place, flag it as a draft binding, and ask the user.

477	## Editing operations
478	
479	Safe, surgical edits on an existing `.bpmn` (preserve content you did not author
480	— see [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md#editing-an-existing-bpmn-preserve-what-you-did-not-author)):
481	
482	- **Add / delete / reconnect a node**: add the element with a stable id and its
483	  `<bpmn:incoming>`/`<bpmn:outgoing>` refs, add the sequence-flow elements in the
484	  owning scope, and add/update its `BPMNShape` and edge waypoints. On delete,
485	  remove orphaned flows and DI edges and recheck entry-point variables, output
486	  mappings, and binding references.
487	- **Insert a gateway**: split the existing sequence flow into an incoming and an
488	  outgoing flow, add conditions to the outgoing flows plus one `default`, add a
489	  matching join only if branches actually need synchronization, then re-waypoint
490	  the diagram (gateway shape + all edges).
491	- **Move logic into a subprocess**: move only elements that share a valid scope,
492	  re-scope their variables, recreate legal subprocess flow boundaries, and add a
493	  second diagram plane for the subprocess so nested content renders.
494	- **Add an entry point**: use a root-level start event, add a stable unique
495	  `uipath:entryPointId`, and declare input/output variables whose `elementId`
496	  matches that start event.
497	
498	Do not patch generated JSON to fix source behavior — change the `.bpmn` and
499	regenerate. For `Intsvc.*` activities/triggers, hand editing to CLI enrichment.
500	
501	### Edit red-flags
502	
503	Re-check after any edit:
504	
505	- A diagram plane references a missing process, collaboration, or subprocess.
506	- A rendered element lacks a shape or its flow lacks an edge/waypoint.
507	- An entry-point variable points at the wrong start event.
508	- A `uipath:context` value references a missing binding.
509	- A topology edit rewrote unrelated `uipath:*` extension XML.
510	- An Integration Service element carries hand-authored connection details.
511	
512	## Validation
513	
514	Validate with the CLI — it runs the full PO.Frontend canvas rule set offline
515	(the same Node/Edge/CanvasState reconstruction and every canvas rule), plus the
516	deploy-readiness checks:
517	
518	```bash
519	uip maestro bpmn validate <file.bpmn> --output json
520	```
521	
522	Exit 0 means the document passes all rules. Exit 1 lists the blocking errors,
523	each with its rule code (gateway/condition, fake-join, superfluous-gateway,
524	error end/boundary event, timer-duration/required-field, single-blank-start,
525	single-conditional-outgoing-flow, variable-reference, method-parentheses,
526	input-type, event-object, and IS-connector checks). Warnings are reported but do
527	not block. If `validate` is unknown or runs only deploy-readiness checks, update
528	the CLI — see [cli-conventions.md](cli-conventions.md#discovery-commands-read-only-authoring-safe).
529	
530	If the CLI is unavailable, fall back to a well-formed-XML parse plus the
531	structural checklist below — it mirrors the same blocking rules:
532	
533	```bash
534	python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ET.parse('<file.bpmn>')"
535	```
536	
537	Then walk the structural checklist:
538	
539	1. Root is `<…:definitions>` with the BPMN + `uipath` namespaces.
540	2. Exactly one `<bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>` with a shape per node and an edge per flow.
541	3. Every `sourceRef`/`targetRef`/`attachedToRef`/`*Ref` resolves to a declared id.
542	4. Each XOR gateway: non-default flows have conditions; exactly one default.
543	5. No activity/event has more than one incoming flow.
544	6. Each event subprocess has exactly one start event, and it carries an event
545	   definition (with `isInterrupting`).
546	7. Every `vars.<id>` reference resolves to a declared variable.
